Parse tree

Every record in file order, indented by container depth.

World state

Per-entity records from the world-state container (key 6d87f588): each entry is a 16-byte entity GUID from the game's prefab files and a typed record stream. Entities are labelled from the embedded index of the game's prefabs; entries that are not a record stream keep their raw bytes. Record meanings are hash-recovered names, not verified gameplay effects.
